The new mixed, eight-print and corner assets have clean studio backdrops; the peel view retains the previous product photo. Blur the printed mark, text and QR code on the full-sheet product photos. Keep the four product views after photo selection; show the personal full sheet in the print preview and checkout only. Leaving the preview restores the current product view. personalBusiness.projectAndHelpSearch: dedicated page scoped to its source; results and empty state share that page
personalBusiness.recentPhotoLine: manual horizontal scrolling only; keep position after release; individual prints gently sway unless reduced motion is enabled
personalBusiness.collectionCaptureMethods: The 请选择采集方式 sheet uses the shared grip and 18px title above an equal-width two- or three-column utility grid of project-enabled methods. Each option pairs a 48px transparent blue-white 3D icon with a 13px dark label at weight 650 and a 12px soft-blue caption (#547396). Icon objects are the phone front with a framing reticle, the phone back with rear lenses, and a phone screen with album thumbnails. The rear icon carries a compact red 推荐 pill at its lower-right corner, using the shared recommendation colors and type. The single-lens case opens its guide directly, and the single-album case opens the system file picker directly. Missing configuration defaults to three methods.
personalBusiness.collectionShootingGuide: Open a white bottom sheet at approximately 90% of the device height, below the status bar. Below the shared grip, one heading stacks a left-aligned 15px lens line and a 22px action line. The pale-blue 3:4 positioning illustration fills the content column width, with 20px between the heading and image. The fixed, non-scrolling content column is up to 288px wide and includes a four-step ordered list in 15px text. All content and the fixed 48px minimum Enter Camera button fit in one view on the 402×874 prototype canvas. The action uses the shared collection primary action and bottom safe area. Closing a guide restores the originating grid and focus or the task detail when the project has one lens. Saved per-mode opt-outs apply when a lens is chosen from the grid.
personalBusiness.priceDisplay: Known monetary values use price-ink across result and payment surfaces. Status text and unknown amount placeholders retain their own semantics.

personalCameraResults.defaultSelection: Prefer available retouched; fall back to available ordinary. Preserve prior selection or an existing order; require a ready usable result for purchase.
personalCameraResults.card: Neutral canvas and centered unlock heading above a shared preview card. Outlined spec, background and pixel chips align to the left inside the card above the photos. Side-by-side previews place ordinary left and retouched right, with a light blue outline and a top-left version label for retouched. Unpaid previews show a translucent diagonal watermark on the lower half of each photo, followed by one comparison button. Stacked cards place radios in a separate left column and align title, description and dark-green checkmarks on pale green circles. Retouched has a lower-right orange diagonal ribbon with the supplied white prototype copy. The footer pairs a single 24px red amount with a brand-blue action naming the version.
personalCameraResults.comparison: Full-screen dark viewer; drag image or 44px divider at 1x, drag divider or pan image at higher zoom; pinch 1–3x and double tap 1x/2x around the touch point. Keep only the close button, labels and photo controls. Closing restores the previous selection and trigger focus. Version selection stays on the result page. The divider supports keyboard input.

albumSpaces.contentCard: shared white card radius and shadow, 14px inline inset, fixed 16px title and right 管理, scrollable content below the header; My Photos keeps its grid and existing batch selection with the tabs hidden during management
albumSpaces.folderGrid: three equal columns; 4:3 cover with a pale-blue folder back and a translucent frosted lip using the shared masthead material and solid fallback; left-aligned 13px name and 12px count
albumSpaces.family: per member ID; first photo in front with up to two more fanned behind; shared blue silhouette placeholder when the first photo is unavailable and 空相册 at zero; member opens SharedSheet with dated photo grid and fixed add-photo footer, returning restores position; inside a nonempty member sheet 管理 starts multi-select with select-all/cancel and a soft-danger delete footer; confirming removes only selected copies and returns to browsing; folder-level Manage opens add, rename and remove actions; name only, trimmed and max 30 chars; whole-album deletion confirms the member and photo count and retains source photos and associated documents with holder name snapshot; stale confirmation requires reconfirming
albumSpaces.addPhoto: shared picker: the device album selects one ID photo and saves directly after ID-photo validation and the device compression consent if required, with errors and retry in the picker. Web demonstrates a pass without recognizing the photo and shows 证件照校验通过（演示），已添加 in the member list. Take a member photo uses the same full-screen personal camera; its photo confirmation with 重拍 and 使用这张照片 stays unchanged, with a demonstration result on web and an actual one-face check in native apps. My Photos copies a finished photo.
albumSpaces.documents: Keep the three-column holder folders and fixed 本人. Open a dedicated standard secondary page with a 52px white navigation bar, canvas body and fixed 添加证件. Cards use a 16px radius, 16px inset and 12px separation, with a name, count and one 44px edit button. Use two 4:3 cells per row for one or two photos and three per row for three to five. Full-screen viewer offers paging, 1–3× pinch, double tap, pan, save-current with shared Toast, and single-image replacement. The one 编辑证件 sheet stages name, normal removal, replacement and additions for one save. Its 删除整份证件 action uses body ink #53637B. Final-photo and whole-record deletion commit immediately after a centered solid-danger confirmation. Verify stored snapshot and owner, retain originals on errors, enforce five images and the shared 1 MiB phone compression-consent rule.
albumSpaces.phoneCompressionConsent: For the device album in Family Photos and Documents, open one shared centered confirmation per batch if any individual file exceeds 1 MiB. Show the over-limit count and state that the phone original stays unchanged. Buttons: 取消 and 压缩并上传. Only after consent compress the oversized files; leave other files intact. Cancel or Back returns to the picker without importing; any failed batch leaves existing and staged photos intact.
albumSpaces.detail: Shared bottom sheet for mine, single family photo and personal center; left-photo/right-facts summary, featured services, and one fixed download button. Document photos open a paged viewer from the holder’s secondary page. Preserve list position and source focus.

albumSpaces.storage: family and document spaces local per signed-in account
albumSpaces.finishedActions: delete personal and family photos through their respective management selection modes; shared confirmation, cancel, busy guard and retry on failure; unreadable records remain selectable; family deletion affects that member’s copies and retains an empty member

narrative.northStar: 清晰、克制的证件照工作台
narrative.overview:
知拍以照片与当前任务为中心：浅蓝白画布、深蓝文字、知拍蓝主操作和轻质内容卡建立稳定的层级。界面重视横平竖直的对齐、完整的照片呈现与连贯的前后流程，减少重复提示和无关操作。

本次为既有设计体系的合并归档。首页连贯宫格、订单交易票据、原因上滑抽屉和完整等比照片各有明确职责。
keyCharacteristics: 蓝白浅底与深蓝字，主操作、选中和语义状态各司其职。
共享边线、对齐线与间距，按页面任务组织信息密度。
照片完整等比显示；展示比例、原始文件和输出规格分别定义。
保留场景专用组件，原生还原按真实安全区、字体和系统返回适配。

rules.name: 用途分色
rules.body: 品牌蓝表达操作和选中；业务状态按对应场景着色，不把审核状态套到交易付款状态。

rules.name: 一处一个主动作
rules.body: 前景文字与当前操作优先于背景装饰；半透明、弥散和阴影只服务已确认的层次，不增加外发光。

rules.name: 内容自然增高
rules.body: 长名称和数字信息分开承载，允许换行与自然增高，不通过压缩字形或裁切关键信息维持固定高度。

rules.name: 克制分层
rules.body: 普通卡片、悬浮导航与抽屉使用各自阴影；订单票据保持无额外阴影，照片预览不得重新包回白卡。

dos: **Do** 沿用已确认的组件、对齐线和分组方式；设计或布局调整先展示结构样图并等待明确确认，单次豁免仅对当次有效。
**Do** 记录具体场景的最终生效样式和来源；发现文档与实现差异时明示差异，保留已确认规则，不把现状自动升级为新规范。
**Do** 使用系统字体或来源、许可证明确的免费商用开源字体；图片与导出物遵守同一约束。
**Do** 保留至少44px的关键触控区和可见键盘焦点；列表滚动、覆盖层锁定、关闭后的焦点与位置恢复一起验收。
**Do** 将402×874、62px顶部及29px底部标为 Web 预览基准，三端按实际系统安全区、字体缩放与返回机制验证。
**Do** 如实标注原型模拟、代码检查、实际页面抽样与三端验收的范围；默认最终交付给出说明、验证和链接，用户要求时再附截图。
donts: **Don't** 为本次 document 重做页面或换一套品牌；未经确认不新增自定义照片规格。
**Don't** 让订单承担查看照片、排版、继续处理、采集任务或客服；订单照片仅为只读交易识别缩略图。
**Don't** 用整块预览区 Loading、遮罩或状态标签遮住照片；处理动效按相应流程限定在实际照片内，详情大图使用独立查看层。
**Don't** 将规格名称挤掉尺寸、将末行内容压入悬浮菜单，或通过减小字号和拉伸照片解决空间问题。
**Don't** 将工具面板的预览梯度当作已批准的产品色阶，将 HTML 示例当成完整业务实现，或把浏览器样式抽样写成全模块真机验收。
**Don't** 在订单票据恢复点击缩放、卡片展开或共享元素转场。
